title: The Great Eruption Canon
summary: A canon on gathering molten qi under the feet until it breaks upward in a single overwhelming outpouring.

title: Treatise of the Burning River
summary: A treatise on a slow glowing river of liquid stone that the user pours across the ground and steers at will.

title: The Obsidian Crown Mastery
summary: A mastery of glassy black armor and keen edges worn about the head and shoulders like a crown.

title: Sapphire Magma Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of blue-hot magma qi in the Azure Sky style that burns cleaner and far hotter than red.

title: The Gale-Fed Lava Canon
summary: A canon on feeding molten qi with the wind of the gale until it roars hotter than the stone that bore it.

title: Treatise of Cooling Oaths in Stone
summary: A treatise on swearing the cooling of magma into stone at a chosen instant so the form holds exactly as sworn.

title: The Basalt Wall Mastery
summary: A mastery of raising and holding great walls of cooled dark stone that the heat behind them presses to break.

title: Manual of the Smoldering Host
summary: A manual on spreading a slow smoulder through a whole body of foes so that none can rest or hold ground.
